faqs.question: What are tuff tiles?
faqs.answer: Tuff tiles is a trade name for thick interlocking paving pieces, typically concrete, used on driveways, parking areas and footpaths. It is not a technical grade, so ask for the material and thickness in writing.

faqs.question: Are tuff tiles good for driveways in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: They can be, because interlocking pieces share a vehicle load across the surface. Results depend on piece thickness and, above all, a compacted base and drainage fall, so describe your load when you ask for a quote.

faqs.question: How much do tuff tiles cost in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Prices typically depend on material, thickness, size, colour, quantity, city and delivery, and may be quoted per piece or per square foot. Pak Clay does not print an undated rate; ask us for a written quote with unit and date.

faqs.question: Tuff tiles or clay pavers: which should I choose?
faqs.answer: Concrete pavers usually look grey or coloured and even, while clay reads warmer and earthier. Either can serve a driveway if thick and well made, so compare samples for grip, colour and thickness.
